programmes.t: The Little Girl Who Lives Down The Lane
programmes.d: Jodie Foster and Martin Sheen star in this haunting story of a thirteen-year-old girl who lives in an old house with her reclusive father...all alone. Or does she? It seems she is hiding a dark secret, one she is determined to preserve. At any cost!
In this second sequel to 1979's THE AMITYVILLE HORROR, the infamous and dreaded Amityville house on Long Island is once again the centerpiece of terror when it is bought by a skeptical journalist.
A record-store clerk is obsessed with pop diva Angelica and happens to stumble upon a jewellery robbery where the thieves drop one of the items: a cursed pendant that first belonged to Dr. Mesmer.
The grandson of an Indian shaman, who has embraced the white man's medicine and become a doctor, is frustrated by the patients he loses. He then comes across a cursed Indian rattle.

programmes.t: Stephen King's Sometimes They Come Back
programmes.d: A high school teacher (Tim Matheson) faces the demon ghosts of a gang of former students. Brooke Adams, Robert Hy Gorman, Robert Rusler, Nicholas Sadler and William Sanderson also star. Based on a short story by Stephen King.
A mysterious snow globe is mailed to Curious Goods. When Micki gives it a shake, an old boyfriend of hers shows up, and convinces her to join him at a bed & breakfast.
A famous dancer, Anton Pascola, is crippled in an accident before completing his masterpiece, Shiva. He obtains a cursed symphonia (music box).

A young woman arrives at her grandmother's house, which used to be a funeral home, to help her turn the place into a bed-and-breakfast inn. After they open, guests begin disappearing or turning up dead.
